title: Turkish-Style Tofu Menemen
description: A Turkish-inspired twist on the classic Turkish menemen dish, using tofu instead of meat.

ingredients.name: Menemen Spice Mix
ingredients.notes: available at most Middle Eastern markets

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and sauté until translucent (5 minutes).
Add the minced garlic and sauté for another minute.
Add the crumbled tofu and cook until golden brown (5 minutes).
Add the chopped tomato, menemen spice mix, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes.
Serve immediately, garnished with fresh parsley if desired.
Serve with crusty bread or over rice.
